Another on 9 November, 2023

Author: Neeraj Tiwari
Bench: Neeraj Tiwari
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:216899
Court No. - 87
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 14241 of 2021
Applicant :- Ashutosh Dewedi @ Dheeraj And 2 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Krishna Gopal,Amit Kumar Yadav,Bheshaj Puri Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Ashish Dwivedi,Neha Rani,Rajesh Singh Hon'ble Neeraj Tiwari,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned AGA for the State.

2. The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the entire proceedings of Case No.
548 of 2021, arising out of case crime no. 14/2021, under Sections- 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Faridpur, District- Bareilly, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate,
Faridpur, Bareilly.

3. Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that opposite party no. 2 is the wife of applicant no.
1 and between them, other criminal proceedings are pending.

Apart from this case, one more Ashutosh Dewedi @ Dheeraj And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76252784/
1 proceeding under Section 323 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act was initiated against the applicants.

entities.text: Ashutosh Dewedi @ Dheeraj And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The said proceeding was challenged by the applicants by filing Application U/S 482 No. 21142 of 2023 and in that matter, compromise has taken place and after verification of compromise by the Trial Court,
said proceeding was quashed vide order dated 10.10.2023.

He next submitted that present dispute is also between the same parties, therefore, in light of order dated 10.10.2023 passed in Application U/S 482 No. 21142 of 2023, present proceeding may also be quashed.
4. Learned AGA has not objected the aforesaid fact and submitted that in case proceedings is quashed, he would have no objection.
5. In view of above, the applicants and opposite party no. 2 do not want to pursue the case any further as stated by them.
The matter has been mutually settled between the parties, therefore, no useful purpose would be served in proceeding with the matter further.

6. Thus in view of the well settled principle of law as laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the matters of Krishnappa & Ors. vs. State of Karnataka; 2021 0 Supreme(SC) 529, Parbatbhai Aahir @
Parbatbhai Bhimsinhbhai Karmur and Ors. vs. State of Gujarat and another; 2017 9 SCC 641, B.S.
Joshi Vs. State of Haryana; 2003(4) SCC 675, Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Burea of Investigation and another; (2008) 9 Supreme Court Cases 677, Gian Singh Vs. Stated of Punjab; (2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh & others Vs. State of Punjab and another; (2014) Supreme Today 642, the proceedings of the aforesaid case is hereby quashed.
7.
